items.title: Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 23, 2003 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Patti Page had a thing called “Doggie in the Window.”

ctx.x: You never quite know what’s going to catch the public’s ear.
No. You never know. Yeah. But in those days a hit record was a glorious thing to have, for an artist to find some — Patti Page had a thing called “Doggie in the Window.”
“How Much is that Doggie in the Window.”
